about.content: I'm a full stack engineer early in my career, passionate about developing systems that prioritize maintainability and scalability, building robust foundations for future growth.

Beyond technical implementation, my favorite work lies at the intersection of design and development. I'm energized by the challenge of translating complex, evolving requirements into elegant, high-performing features that users genuinely enjoy.
I thrive in dynamic environments where I can continuously grow, solve complex problems, and build software that stands the test of time.
Outside of work, I enjoy investing, playing chess, and constantly seeking opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

experience.description: Design and implement low-code web applications and integrated data solutions using Oracle technologies with a focus on APEX and cloud infrastructure. Develop proofs of concept demonstrating the embedding of Oracle Analytics Cloud into applications and real-time data streaming between Kafka and Oracle Data Warehouse. Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to architect database and integration solutions that address specific technical requirements. Optimize development efficiency by creating reusable solution components to accelerate delivery timelines for similar business needs.

Designed and deployed Oracle APEX applications, architecting efficient data model (PL/SQL) and optimizing RESTful API integrations to improve front-end performance by 30%. Utilized Javascript for APEX-built-in APIs and AJAX callbacks to streamline server-side data operations. Automated manual testing and data validation tasks using Selenium Python, cutting operational workload by 65%. Managed version control and collaborative development directly within Oracle APEX, ensuring code integrity and team alignment.

projects.description: JavaFX application to manage jogging spots, with MySQL backend and CRUD functionality. Users filter locations by category (e.g., parks, stadiums) and modify data via a graphical interface.

Java console application for hotel administration, featuring room inventory management, dynamic pricing updates, member registration, reservation handling, revenue analytics, and promotional lucky draws—all via a command-line interface.

about_website.content: I built this portfolio completely from scratch - no templates, no frameworks. Just me, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It's been a fun challenge to create everything myself while keeping it clean and responsive.

items.content: Mobile-friendly design that works on any device
Subtle interactive touches to make it feel alive

about_website.content: The design was inspired by portfolio I admire, but every line of code is my own. Building this taught me so much about CSS layouts and creating smooth user experiences.
